questions.Description: Glossary of terms related to the various parts and positions of fishing boat.
Drawing practice of deck layout of Stern trawl, out rigger trawler, persue seiner, long liner, troll liner.
Fabrication of net – 10x10 meshes, 20x20 meshes – Shaping of net – baiting – Creasing – Tailoring.
Definition of Mesh and types of meshes – Rhombic mesh – Square mesh – Hexagonal mesh.
Rope work – Splicing – eye splicing – Short, long and back splicing and specification of construction of wire rope.
Identification of Gear materials, cotton, polyethylene, polypropelene, polyester. Floats – High density floats – Low density floats – Glass floats – Thermocole floats.
Drawing practice and design of fishing gears – Trawl net – pursue seine net – Long line – Pole and line – Troll line – Gill nets – Thuri valai – Cast net.
Field visit to net making plant.

Visit to fishing harbour to study the deck layout of mechanised fishing vessels – Trawler – Long liner – Gill netter – Pursue seiner and infrastructural facilities for operation and maintenance of fishing vessels.
Field visit to boat building yard.
